title: Equipping Aymara servants in Desaguadero
excerpt: EPYL returned to the shore of Lake Titicaca: Pastor Juan Valderrama taught the book of Romans to Aymara believers at Alfa y Omega church.
body:
The EPYL ministry keeps equipping Aymara servants. Our vision is simple: to draw believers to the Word of God. These brothers and sisters long to grow and to be transformed into the image of Christ.

At Alfa y Omega church in Desaguadero, Puno, Pastor Juan Valderrama taught through the book of Romans in a simple and practical way, so that believers may live loving God.

Thank you for praying for the Aymara churches of the highlands.

photos.caption: Pastors, leaders and families at the EPYL training in Desaguadero.
“Let us put on the armor of light” — Romans 13:12, Ephesians 6:11.

title: The highlands of Peru are beautiful
excerpt: At 3,800 metres, Desaguadero sits on the shore of Lake Titicaca. Come and see where the Aymara churches live and serve.
body:
The sierra of Peru is beautiful. After a day of teaching we climbed the hill above Desaguadero: the town below, Lake Titicaca to the horizon, and the snow peaks behind it.

This is the land of the Aymara churches we serve. If your church is praying about a mission trip to Peru, come and see it with your own eyes.

photos.caption: Desaguadero, on the border between Peru and Bolivia.
